conceptZh: 玩具機器人和閃電拔河，彈簧一放，人字彈進門裡。
object: mismatched toy robot with a spring lightning bolt
morph: 人 snaps into the 門 frame
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy, locked frontal camera. Setting: a pale-magenta wall and cream floor; the glyph is bright purple 閃: the 門 frame with a 人 inside. A boxy toy robot with one longer arm stands at left; a spring-mounted toy lightning bolt wobbles at right. The Traditional Chinese glyph 閃 stays centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the robot grabs a spring and tugs the 人 shape while the lightning bolt tugs the other way; the first 閃 is spoken as they pull. Moment two (1.8-3.5s): the spring goes taut and releases: the 人 shape zips into the 門 and the posts clap closed; the second 閃 is spoken at the clap, the robot leaning like a leaf. Moment three (3.5-5.0s): the toy lightning bolt dashes sideways and the robot leaps out of its way in a clumsy long-arm tumble; 閃電 is spoken as the bolt flashes once (gently, no strobe). From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 閃 is perfectly still and unobstructed; the robot straightens and clicks his long arm into place; the glyph is still. Narration (off-screen only, Taiwanese Mandarin, unhurried, every tone clear, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「閃、閃、閃電」, read as ㄕㄢˇ、ㄕㄢˇ、ㄕㄢˇ ㄉㄧㄢˋ. Timing: first utterance at about 0.5s, second at about 2.5s, the word at about 4.4s; then stop, no repeats and no extra speech. Beneath the voice only spring twangs and a soft zip, no music. The single glyph is the only on-screen text; the vocabulary stays audio-only with no subtitles, watermark, clutter or flashing.
